description: Search Vietnamese administrative units by name or code, ignoring case and diacritics. scope "new" (default) searches the post-reform units (34 provinces, 3,321 communes); scope "old" searches units as of 30 June 2025 (63 provinces, districts, communes). Use to check spelling, get a code, or see every place with the same name before converting. Returns code, full name, level, match quality (code, exact, partial) and parent district/province. Examples: {"query":"Bến Nghé","scope":"old"}; {"query":"thu duc"}; {"query":"Tân Phú","scope":"old","level":"ward","province":"79","limit":20}.

level.description: Restrict to one level. "district" exists only with scope "old".

province.description: Optional province filter in the same scope: code or name.

query.description: Unit name or code to look up, e.g. "Bến Nghé", "ben nghe", "Thủ Đức", "26734". Case and diacritics are ignored.

scope.description: "new" (default): units after the 2025 reform (34 provinces, 3,321 communes). "old": units as of 30 June 2025 (63 provinces, districts, 10,035 communes).

name: find_units
title: Find administrative units by name
